# BYZ scope. .2: 40% a month, sure in the 6th month after Umur is first seen dead.
oe_bey_ch_2 = { value = 40 if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_m var:oe_bey_umur_m >= 6 } value = 100 } }
# BYZ scope. World steps W-1..W-4: 100 / months left in the window, so every month of the window is equally likely and
# the last one is sure (C4's way).
oe_bey_wleft_1 = { value = 141 subtract = var:oe_bey_m min = 1 }
oe_bey_wch_1 = { value = 100 divide = oe_bey_wleft_1 }
oe_bey_wleft_2 = { value = 157 subtract = var:oe_bey_m min = 1 }
oe_bey_wch_2 = { value = 100 divide = oe_bey_wleft_2 }
oe_bey_wleft_3 = { value = 13 subtract = var:oe_bey_m min = 1 }
oe_bey_wch_3 = { value = 100 divide = oe_bey_wleft_3 }
oe_bey_wleft_4 = { value = 73 subtract = var:oe_bey_m min = 1 }
oe_bey_wch_4 = { value = 100 divide = oe_bey_wleft_4 }

# BYZ scope. 牵制 (the counterweight, design 3.9), 0-7: how many of the seven emirates (Aydin, Saruhan, Germiyan,
# Karaman, Menteshe, Kastamonu, Karesi) exist, are not the Ottomans' subjects, border the Ottomans or their subjects and
# are not hostile to the empire. Read only: not stored, changes nothing (later phases and L5 / N4 read it).
oe_bey_counterweight = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KRD c:KRD = { oe_bey_cw_one = yes } } add = 1 }
}
